data.long_meaning: Ajru is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ajr’, which means ‘unconquered’, ‘invincible’ or ‘brave’. It is a name that is associated with strength, courage, and victory. In Hindu mythology, Ajru is also a name of a goddess, who is worshipped for her protection and blessings. The name Ajru carries the meaning “Brave, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Ajru usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ajru is a name that inspires courage and strength. It is a name that signifies the power to overcome challenges and adversities. It is a name that represents the indomitable spirit of a warrior and the unwavering determination to succeed.
data.etymology: Ajru belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajru total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
